crossRefs.note: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and…
Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff…

translations.web: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.
translations.bsb: But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.
translations.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
translations.asv: But thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain by the sword.
